subject: Mechanic kickoff — kill manual LR tuning
body:
Team,

Kicking off the Mechanic rollout. The pitch is simple: our open-source Mechanic tuner learns the learning-rate scale factor of any base optimizer automatically — in the paper's evaluations across large-scale deep learning tasks it comes close to, matches, or beats manual tuning. Internally, teams burn real GPU-weeks on LR sweeps. The integration is genuinely two lines: keep your schedule at base LR 1.0 and wrap the optimizer with mechanic.mechanize(adamw).

Milestones (window closes 2026-05-04):
- 02-27: exact jax/optax implementation vendored into the training stack behind a flag.
- 03-27: A/B across 3 internal workloads with different batch sizes and schedules.
- 04-24: rollout recommendation + docs for the platform review.

Santiago owns staffing; Rafael is TL. If the A/B holds up, this is the cheapest win of the half.

Ximena
